program.name: Oblique Mat
program.subject: Mat core
program.blurb: Long Pilates sessions for the sides of the core: twists, side bends and side planks.
program.about: The obliques on the Pilates mat. One day is criss-cross, saw, spine twist, corkscrew and side bends; the other is side planks, star, hip twists and mermaid. Both open with the hundred and close with rolling. They alternate. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
program.split: Twist & side bend / side plank & rotation
